0d2eb4601e33.name: Crassus
0d2eb4601e33.plain: This model can carry up to 35 ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models, though some take extra room. A Heavy Weapon Team or Veteran Heavy Weapon Team model fills the space of 2 models, and an OGRYN model fills the space of 3.

23b4ba1739c3.name: Drill Commander (Aura)
23b4ba1739c3.plain: Aura: while one of your MILITARUM TEMPESTUS INFANTRY units is within 6" of this WARLORD, its models double their Rapid Fire attacks at any range. This replaces the usual Rapid Fire rule: for example, a Rapid Fire 1 weapon makes 2 attacks whatever the distance to the target.

25315fd16cce.name: Subterranean Assault
25315fd16cce.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit underground rather than on the battlefield, and one COMBAT ENGINEER SQUAD unit can go underground alongside it. Later, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, you can bring this unit and any unit that went underground with it onto the battlefield: set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere more than 9" from enemy models.

2c69d988baf0.name: Arvus Lighter
2c69d988baf0.plain: This model has room for 12 RENEGADES AND HERETICS INFANTRY models, but it can't carry OGRYNS. Every Heavy Weapon Team takes up the space of two other models.

33a13406517d.name: Vehicle Squadron
33a13406517d.plain: When this unit is first set up, every model in it must be placed within 6" of each other. After that, each model acts on its own and counts as a separate unit for all rules purposes.

55a7b5111fc1.name: Old Grudges
55a7b5111fc1.plain: Pick an enemy unit at the start of the first battle round; your PLATOON or BATTLE TANK SQUADRON units within 6" of this WARLORD add 1 to wound rolls against it. For the rest of the battle, this WARLORD has this ability: OLD GRUDGES (Aura): while one of your PLATOON or BATTLE TANK SQUADRON units is within 6" of this WARLORD, each time one of its models attacks the picked enemy unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

5a2cad9fc851.name: Melta Cutter Drill
5a2cad9fc851.plain: This weapon automatically hits a BUILDING, and its attacks that target a VEHICLE unit have a Damage characteristic of 6.

5ad7139646c3.name: Precision Targeting (Aura)
5ad7139646c3.plain: Aura: targets of ranged attacks by your MILITARUM TEMPESTUS INFANTRY units within 6" of this WARLORD get no benefit of cover against those attacks.

61d78a9e1553.name: Born Soldiers
61d78a9e1553.plain: Ranged attacks by models with this doctrine wound automatically on an unmodified hit roll of 6, and its Officers lend their Leadership to nearby Platoons. Units with this doctrine also get the Born Soldiers keyword, and every Officer with this doctrine has this aura: Born Soldiers (Aura): while one of your Platoon units is within 6" of this model, its models use this Officer's Leadership characteristic rather than their own.

743ef35db02c.name: Disembarking Officers
743ef35db02c.plain: In your Movement phase, when an OFFICER from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT model, it can issue Orders as though it were your Command phase once its unit is set up. Orders issued this way never benefit from Regimental Tactics, even if every model in your army has the ASTRA MILITARUM keyword. An OFFICER cannot do this if the TRANSPORT it disembarked from was destroyed.

7a76bed79b1b.name: Brood Brothers
7a76bed79b1b.plain: Units with this Regimental Doctrine add 2 to their models' Leadership characteristic, and INFANTRY units with it also gain the Unquestioning Loyalty ability.

7ca54bd6ff9b.name: Front-Line Combatant
7ca54bd6ff9b.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, add 1 to the wound roll, and each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 2 extra hits.

7e88594eeb43.name: Designer's Note (forgeworld)
7e88594eeb43.plain: When you add this unit to your army, pick the forgeworld it comes from. Use that name wherever the <FORGEWORLD> keyword appears on this datasheet.

81b3853c250b.name: Heavy Bombs
81b3853c250b.plain: Once per turn, the bearer can drop one of its remaining heavy bombs, which can deal mortal wounds to units within 6" of a point it moved over. Right after the bearer has moved, you can pick one point on the battlefield that it crossed this phase. Roll one D6 for every unit within 6" of that point, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit (excluding VEHICLE and MONSTER units). A roll of 4-5 deals D3 mortal wounds to the unit rolled for, and a 6 deals D6 mortal wounds. No heavy bomb can be dropped more than once per battle.

9200ac4f4f50.name: Whirling Blades
9200ac4f4f50.plain: Against melee attacks, this model gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

9d5c4c519755.name: Artillery and Crew (Rapier Laser Destroyer)
9d5c4c519755.plain: Each Rapier Laser Destroyer and its crew count as one model for all rules purposes, and the crew must stay within 1" of their Rapier Laser Destroyer. The crew can't be targeted or attacked on their own, and visibility and every range are measured to and from the Rapier Laser Destroyer model rather than its crew. This unit can't Advance, can never charge or perform a Heroic Intervention, and can't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

a40923160a1d.name: Arvus Lighter
a40923160a1d.plain: This model has room for 12 ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models, but it can't carry OGRYNS. Every Heavy Weapon Team or Veteran Heavy Weapon Team takes up the space of two other models.

b77626f58c21.name: Specialist Operators
b77626f58c21.plain: In a Battle-forged army, each Detachment can include at most one of this unit for every COMBAT ENGINEER SQUAD unit in that Detachment.

c183cc2f0886.name: Superior Tactical Training
c183cc2f0886.plain: This WARLORD learns one extra type of Orders: when you pick this trait, choose Regimental, Prefectus or Mechanized Orders that it doesn't already know. It then knows those Orders on top of any others it knows.

c37983e144d6.name: Master Tactician
c37983e144d6.plain: At the start of the first battle round, you can redeploy up to three of your ASTRA MILITARUM units (but no TITANIC units) wholly within your deployment zone. Take the chosen units off the battlefield, then set them up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within your deployment zone. If your mission uses the Strategic Reserves rules, you can put any of them into Strategic Reserves instead.

d8432bbfa886.name: Grand Strategist
d8432bbfa886.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, roll a D6 for each Command point you spend on a Stratagem; on a 5+, you get that Command point back.

dca8c96dc42f.name: Uncompromising Prosectuion (Aura)
dca8c96dc42f.plain: Aura: your MILITARUM TEMPESTUS INFANTRY units within 6" of this WARLORD get 1 better Armour Penetration on ranged attacks at half range. Each time one of their models shoots at a unit within half range, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

dfc3ace31ff2.name: Lead by Example
dfc3ace31ff2.plain: This WARLORD can give Orders to its own unit, despite the usual rule that OFFICER units can't be picked to receive Orders.

fa5ad39ed78d.name: Leading from the Front
fa5ad39ed78d.plain: As long as this model is within 1" of any enemy model, every one of your ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of it passes Morale tests automatically.
